description: Suggest a brand architecture model per product. Give `products` as lines 'Name | audience=same | category=overlap | risk=low | standalone=no | acquired=no' (or objects with those keys) and optionally `company`. audience and category take same, overlap or different relative to the parent; risk is the chance a problem with one damages the other (low, medium, high); standalone says whether it needs an identity that can live alone; acquired says whether you bought it. Returns branded house, house of brands or endorsed brand for each with scores, the reasons, which facts were missing and treated as neutral, an example naming pattern, and an overall tally with a note when the portfolio is mixed. Scoring is our own simple rule, a starting point for discussion.

company.description: Parent company or master brand name

products.description: Products, one per line as 'Name | key=value | ...', or an array of objects
